about.title: About
about.body:
Anvil runs as a standalone web app at jansick.com/anvil.

## Install on iPhone
- Open the page in Safari
- Tap the Share button
- Choose **Add to Home Screen**

It then launches full screen, without browser chrome, like a native app.
